items.title: Henry Russ Interview, 1972-01-18
items.q: Fred Marble was on the board. He came—he came up there, tried to get me to go on the board with him.

ctx.x: So I played with the Silitone office, you know, I was dancing from the Nola band to the Silitone office. Uh-huh. And I played the Silitone office for about six, seven years. About five or six years. And I—not the Silitone, I mean including the whole entire band. Yeah. There was a depression set in. T-Rone was practically the biggest band in the city. And while I was playing on the Pelican, you know it was the Silitone band, Fred Marble was on the board. He came—he came up there, tried to get me to go on the board…
Remember who was in the band? Huh? Remember who was in that band?
